items.question: What is FrostyFi?
items.answer: FrostyFi is a visual platform for building AI agents that act on-chain. Connect a large language model to blockchain operations, HTTP calls, or conditional logic using a drag-and-drop canvas — no smart-contract expertise required. Deploy your agent, expose it via a standard API, and let it run autonomously.

items.question: Do I need to write code?
items.answer: No. FrostyFi's no-code visual builder lets you wire together AI models, on-chain actions, and external APIs by dragging nodes onto a canvas. Power users can drop in custom JavaScript nodes for anything the built-in library doesn't cover.

items.question: Which chains and AI models are supported?
items.answer: On the blockchain side, FrostyFi supports EVM-compatible networks (Ethereum, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, and more) as well as Solana. For AI, you can route requests through OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq, and additional providers via OpenRouter — swap models per node without rebuilding your workflow.

items.question: How do payments work?
items.answer: Two layers: the app itself runs on simple USDC subscriptions on Base (Pro and Enterprise tiers) — pay in stablecoin, no NFT and no token required. Agent-to-agent payments use x402 — a per-request micropayment standard that settles in USDC on Base with no intermediary. Your agents can charge callers and pay other agents without any manual invoicing.

items.question: What is x402?
items.answer: x402 is an open standard that uses the HTTP 402 "Payment Required" response to let a client pay for a request and instantly retry — no accounts, API keys or subscriptions. On FrostyFi, your agents can charge per call in USDC on Base and pay other agents the same way, so an API or agent gets paid the moment it's used.

items.question: What is ERC-8004?
items.answer: ERC-8004 is an Ethereum standard for "trustless agents": it gives every agent a portable on-chain identity and reputation through public registries, so counterparties can verify who they're paying and trusting. FrostyFi can register your agent on the ERC-8004 registry in one click, so it carries a verifiable identity that lives on-chain.

items.question: Is there a $FROST token?
items.answer: $FROST is FrostyFi's protocol token. It has not launched yet — TGE is to be determined — and nothing on FrostyFi requires it today; subscriptions are simple USDC payments on Base. When it launches, $FROST is earned by paying customers (100M hard cap, no presale), and you can lock it into a soulbound PERMA position to earn USDC yield from protocol-owned liquidity and a cut of DAO earnings. No NFT and no token purchase is needed to use FrostyFi now.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Sign up at app.frostylabs.ai. The free tier gives you access to the visual builder and a set of AI calls per month to explore the platform. No wallet setup is required to register — connect a wallet later when you want to use on-chain features.

pillars.title: $FROST — earned, not sold
pillars.body: 100M hard cap. Paying customers earn it through finite, revenue-linked emissions — no presale, no VC, no insider round. The rate halves every $25k the product earns.

pillars.title: Lock for real yield
pillars.body: Lock $FROST into a soulbound PERMA position and earn a share of protocol revenue in USDC — POL trading fees plus a cut of DAO earnings. Holding alone earns nothing.

pillars.title: Protocol-Owned Liquidity
pillars.body: A third of every payment routes to POL. It accumulates as USDC — never spent — and becomes permanent FROST/USDC liquidity at launch. The reserve only grows.

pillars.title: A DAO that makes money
pillars.body: Not a piggy bank — a treasury that earns: a first-party x402 agent fleet, liquidity bribes, and community-voted investments. A cut of what it makes is paid to lockers.

pillars.title: Burn on use
pillars.body: Spend $FROST on FrostyG4, Architect builds, or priority execution and it is 100% burned. Deflation scales with real usage, not hype.

pillars.title: Owned by builders
pillars.body: Lock to climb the ladder — product discounts, then voting, then proposing. The people creating the value govern it, and own the upside.

callout.label: Accelerating the liquidity
callout.bodyEnd: . After launch, anyone can bond USDC for discounted $FROST — the USDC goes straight into POL, so a single bond can add more depth than months of revenue. Permissionless, publicly priced, and capped by a treasury debt ceiling.
